item.text:
- Validate `items`/`order.items` are arrays and each item has finite, non-negative numeric `price` and `qty`; otherwise malformed input produces crashes or `NaN`.
- Define empty-order behavior: `averageItemPrice([])` divides by zero; return `0` or throw a clear error.
- Clarify/fix `averageItemPrice`: it currently calculates total value per line item, not per unit; divide by summed quantities if “item” means unit.
- Reject invalid totals or discount codes/types in `applyDiscount`; numeric coercion or negative totals can yield misleading results.
- Round money at a defined boundary (ideally store minor units/cents); floating-point arithmetic can make totals inaccurate.
- Escape/sanitize `name` if formatted output is rendered into HTML, to prevent injection.
